population.n_rule: largest N needed at power 0.8 by the validation and holdout simulated families F2, F4, F6 (section 18.3); never the tuning families

design.session1: practice + Phase A (12 blocks, permuted rounds)
design.later_sessions: practice + Phase A-lite (6) + Phase B (10 blocks in two halves of 3 adaptive, 1 probe, 1 comparator; positions counterbalanced, section 12.3)
design.comparator: best fixed assisted regime by session-1 realized utility (rank_fixed_regimes)

utility_weights.primary: the participant's priorities logged with each block's L1 decision

hypotheses.contrast: FULL against PHYSICS_ONLY and against PERSON_STATIC
hypotheses.score: mean per-trial prequential log score summed over complete, ua, correction, veto and log_time (censored: log P(T >= limit)); each outcome also reported
hypotheses.rule: 95% grouped-bootstrap CI of the per-participant mean difference excludes 0

hypotheses.contrast: adaptive Phase B blocks against concurrent assistance_off probe blocks (superiority) and concurrent comparator blocks (non-inferiority)
hypotheses.outcome: mean realized utility per trial (section 21.2), each participant under their own logged priorities
secondary: doubly robust OPE of S_2 and S_3, reported only when G5 passes

hypotheses.hard_invariants: zero violations of A1-A12 (any violation fails the study)
hypotheses.override_rule: adaptive override rate <= concurrent comparator override rate + 5 percentage points
hypotheses.control_rule: B3 control ratings in adaptive blocks non-inferior to concurrent comparator and probe blocks, margin 0.5 on the 1-7 scale

hypotheses.contrast: adaptive UA rate minus assistance_off probe UA rate, concurrent Phase B blocks
hypotheses.rule: upper 95% bound of the difference <= +2 percentage points

hypotheses.contrast: target-posterior Brier score with and without the gaze prior, idle UA not raised
FULL started from the leave-one-participant-out population prior against POPULATION (the same prior, no person updates)
FULL against SESSION_ONLY on the first 24 active trials of sessions 2 and 3
hypotheses.eligibility: participants whose sessions 2 and 3 ran with cross-session learning effective; the rest are counted and left out

ope.refusal: reported as not estimated; never re-run with another threshold, clip, block set or estimator

gates.G5: OPE validity: estimator check >= 43/50 at the human design, in-sample coverage of S_2 and S_3 >= 43/50 (refusals count as not covering), and the human DR estimates of S_2 and S_3 not refused; otherwise not passed (section 19)

exclusions: trials during DPR or size change
failure_handling: report null or negative results unchanged; errata appended, never rewritten
limitations: blocks are announced, so expectations may differ by block type
comparator chosen from about 16 trials per arm (winner's curse)
per-person regime differences are mostly prior-driven
